# Parameter Specification: VocalStrip

**CRITICAL CONTRACT:** This specification is immutable during implementation.
Parameter IDs, types, and ranges must NOT change after Stage 2 (Shell) begins.
UI controls reference these IDs directly; DSP reads these parameters from APVTS.

**Generated by:** UI mockup finalization (ui-finalization-agent, v6)
**Generated date:** 2026-03-20
**Source:** v6-ui.yaml + creative-brief.md

---

## Total Parameter Count

**Total:** 30 parameters
- Float (slider/knob): 22
- Bool (toggle/bypass LED): 4
- Choice (combo/pill switch): 4

---

## Parameter Definitions

### EQ Section (Semi-parametric, 3-band)

#### eq_hp_freq
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 20.0 to 500.0 Hz
- **Default:** 80.0 Hz
- **Skew Factor:** linear (consider log skew for musical response)
- **Unit:** Hz
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 1 left
- **DSP Usage:** High-pass filter cutoff frequency (Butterworth)

#### eq_low_shelf_gain
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** -12.0 to +12.0 dB
- **Default:** 0.0 dB
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** dB
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 1 center
- **DSP Usage:** Low shelf filter gain

#### eq_low_shelf_freq
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 60.0 to 400.0 Hz
- **Default:** 200.0 Hz
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** Hz
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 1 right
- **DSP Usage:** Low shelf filter frequency

#### eq_mid_gain
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** -12.0 to +12.0 dB
- **Default:** 0.0 dB
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** dB
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 2 left
- **DSP Usage:** Mid band peak filter gain

#### eq_mid_freq
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 200.0 to 8000.0 Hz
- **Default:** 1000.0 Hz
- **Skew Factor:** linear (consider log skew for musical response)
- **Unit:** Hz
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 2 center
- **DSP Usage:** Mid band peak filter center frequency (sweepable)

#### eq_mid_q
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.3 to 5.0
- **Default:** 1.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** (dimensionless)
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 2 right
- **DSP Usage:** Mid band peak filter Q (bandwidth)

#### eq_high_shelf_gain
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** -12.0 to +12.0 dB
- **Default:** 0.0 dB
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** dB
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 3 left-center
- **DSP Usage:** High shelf filter gain

#### eq_high_shelf_freq
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 2000.0 to 16000.0 Hz
- **Default:** 8000.0 Hz
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** Hz
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, EQ section row 3 right-center
- **DSP Usage:** High shelf filter frequency

#### eq_bypass
- **Type:** Bool (AudioParameterBool)
- **Range:** false / true
- **Default:** false (EQ active)
- **UI Control:** Bypass LED button, EQ section bottom-center
- **DSP Usage:** Bypass entire EQ section (all 5 filters pass-through)

---

### Compressor Section (VCA-style, transparent)

#### comp_mode
- **Type:** Choice (AudioParameterChoice)
- **Options:** ["Simple", "Manual"]
- **Default:** 0 (Simple)
  > Note: v6-ui.yaml sets default: 1 (Manual active in UI). Confirm which is
  > correct for APVTS — the YAML initial state may reflect the mockup display
  > preference rather than the intended DAW default. Recommended: Simple (0).
- **UI Control:** Pill switch, Comp section top-center
- **DSP Usage:** Selects compressor control mode; in Simple mode, threshold/ratio
  are calculated automatically from comp_amount

#### comp_amount
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 %
- **Default:** 50.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Large rotary knob, Comp section (visible in Simple mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** One-knob compression amount; maps to threshold/ratio internally

#### comp_threshold
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** -60.0 to 0.0 dB
- **Default:** -18.0 dB
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** dB
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Comp section row 1 left (visible in Manual mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** VCA compressor threshold level

#### comp_ratio
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 1.0 to 20.0
- **Default:** 4.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** :1
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Comp section row 1 center (visible in Manual mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** VCA compressor compression ratio

#### comp_attack
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.1 to 100.0 ms
- **Default:** 10.0 ms
- **Skew Factor:** linear (consider log skew)
- **Unit:** ms
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Comp section row 2 left (visible in Manual mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** VCA compressor attack time

#### comp_release
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 10.0 to 1000.0 ms
- **Default:** 200.0 ms
- **Skew Factor:** linear (consider log skew)
- **Unit:** ms
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Comp section row 2 center (visible in Manual mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** VCA compressor release time

#### comp_makeup
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 24.0 dB
- **Default:** 0.0 dB
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** dB
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Comp section row 1 right (always visible)
- **DSP Usage:** Post-compressor makeup gain

#### comp_bypass
- **Type:** Bool (AudioParameterBool)
- **Range:** false / true
- **Default:** false (Compressor active)
- **UI Control:** Bypass LED button, Comp section bottom-center
- **DSP Usage:** Bypass entire compressor section

---

### Delay Section

#### delay_mode
- **Type:** Choice (AudioParameterChoice)
- **Options:** ["Slapback", "Sync"]
- **Default:** 0 (Slapback)
- **UI Control:** Pill switch, Delay section top-center
- **DSP Usage:** Selects delay mode; Slapback uses delay_time, Sync uses delay_division + BPM

#### delay_time
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 20.0 to 200.0 ms
- **Default:** 100.0 ms
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** ms
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Delay section upper row (visible in Slapback mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** Delay time in milliseconds (Slapback mode)

#### delay_division
- **Type:** Choice (AudioParameterChoice)
- **Options:** ["1/16", "1/8", "1/4", "1/2"]
- **Default:** 1 (1/8)
- **UI Control:** 4-button division group, Delay section upper row (visible in Sync mode only)
- **DSP Usage:** Tempo-synced delay note division (reads AudioPlayHead BPM)

#### delay_feedback
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 90.0 %
- **Default:** 20.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Delay section lower row left (always visible)
- **DSP Usage:** Delay feedback amount (amount of delayed signal fed back into delay line)

#### delay_mix
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 %
- **Default:** 30.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Delay section lower row center (always visible)
- **DSP Usage:** Delay wet/dry mix

#### delay_reverb_send
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 %
- **Default:** 20.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Horizontal slider, Delay section below lower row (always visible)
- **DSP Usage:** Amount of delay output fed into reverb input (pre-reverb send)

#### delay_bypass
- **Type:** Bool (AudioParameterBool)
- **Range:** false / true
- **Default:** false (Delay active)
- **UI Control:** Bypass LED button, Delay section bottom-center
- **DSP Usage:** Bypass entire delay section

---

### Reverb Section

#### reverb_type
- **Type:** Choice (AudioParameterChoice)
- **Options:** ["Plate", "Room"]
- **Default:** 0 (Plate)
- **UI Control:** Pill switch, Reverb section top-center
- **DSP Usage:** Selects reverb character/algorithm preset (Plate or Room)

#### reverb_predelay
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 ms
- **Default:** 20.0 ms
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** ms
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Reverb section row 1 left
- **DSP Usage:** Pre-delay before reverb tail begins

#### reverb_decay
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.3 to 8.0 s
- **Default:** 1.5 s
- **Skew Factor:** linear (consider log skew for musical response)
- **Unit:** s
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Reverb section row 1 right
- **DSP Usage:** Reverb tail decay time (RT60)

#### reverb_damping
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 %
- **Default:** 50.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Reverb section row 2 left
- **DSP Usage:** High-frequency damping in reverb tail

#### reverb_mix
- **Type:** Float (AudioParameterFloat)
- **Range:** 0.0 to 100.0 %
- **Default:** 25.0 %
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **Unit:** %
- **UI Control:** Rotary knob, Reverb section row 2 right
- **DSP Usage:** Reverb wet/dry mix

#### reverb_bypass
- **Type:** Bool (AudioParameterBool)
- **Range:** false / true
- **Default:** false (Reverb active)
- **UI Control:** Bypass LED button, Reverb section bottom-center
- **DSP Usage:** Bypass entire reverb section

## APVTS Construction Reference

Parameters must be added to AudioProcessorValueTreeState in this order
(order determines automation lane ordering in DAW):

```cpp
juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::ParameterLayout createParameterLayout()
{
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<juce::RangedAudioParameter>> params;

    // EQ
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_hp_freq", "HP Freq", 20.0f, 500.0f, 80.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_low_shelf_gain", "Low Shelf Gain", -12.0f, 12.0f, 0.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_low_shelf_freq", "Low Shelf Freq", 60.0f, 400.0f, 200.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_mid_gain", "Mid Gain", -12.0f, 12.0f, 0.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_mid_freq", "Mid Freq", 200.0f, 8000.0f, 1000.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_mid_q", "Mid Q", 0.3f, 5.0f, 1.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_high_shelf_gain", "Hi Shelf Gain", -12.0f, 12.0f, 0.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "eq_high_shelf_freq", "Hi Shelf Freq", 2000.0f, 16000.0f, 8000.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterBool>(
        "eq_bypass", "EQ Bypass", false));

    // Compressor
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterChoice>(
        "comp_mode", "Comp Mode",
        juce::StringArray{"Simple", "Manual"}, 0));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_amount", "Comp Amount", 0.0f, 100.0f, 50.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_threshold", "Threshold", -60.0f, 0.0f, -18.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_ratio", "Ratio", 1.0f, 20.0f, 4.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_attack", "Attack", 0.1f, 100.0f, 10.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_release", "Release", 10.0f, 1000.0f, 200.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "comp_makeup", "Makeup Gain", 0.0f, 24.0f, 0.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterBool>(
        "comp_bypass", "Comp Bypass", false));

    // Delay
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterChoice>(
        "delay_mode", "Delay Mode",
        juce::StringArray{"Slapback", "Sync"}, 0));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "delay_time", "Delay Time", 20.0f, 200.0f, 100.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterChoice>(
        "delay_division", "Delay Division",
        juce::StringArray{"1/16", "1/8", "1/4", "1/2"}, 1));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "delay_feedback", "Feedback", 0.0f, 90.0f, 20.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "delay_mix", "Delay Mix", 0.0f, 100.0f, 30.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "delay_reverb_send", "Reverb Send", 0.0f, 100.0f, 20.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterBool>(
        "delay_bypass", "Delay Bypass", false));

    // Reverb
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterChoice>(
        "reverb_type", "Reverb Type",
        juce::StringArray{"Plate", "Room"}, 0));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "reverb_predelay", "Pre-Delay", 0.0f, 100.0f, 20.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "reverb_decay", "Decay", 0.3f, 8.0f, 1.5f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "reverb_damping", "Damping", 0.0f, 100.0f, 50.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat>(
        "reverb_mix", "Reverb Mix", 0.0f, 100.0f, 25.0f));
    params.push_back(std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterBool>(
        "reverb_bypass", "Reverb Bypass", false));

    return { params.begin(), params.end() };
}
```

## Signal Flow Reference

```
[Mono Input]
    |
    v
  [EQ] -- eq_bypass bypasses all 5 filters
    |   HP filter (eq_hp_freq)
    |   Low shelf (eq_low_shelf_gain, eq_low_shelf_freq)
    |   Mid peak  (eq_mid_gain, eq_mid_freq, eq_mid_q)
    |   High shelf (eq_high_shelf_gain, eq_high_shelf_freq)
    |
    v
  [Compressor] -- comp_bypass bypasses
    |   Mode: Simple (comp_amount) or Manual (threshold/ratio/attack/release)
    |   comp_makeup applied after compression
    |
    v
  [Delay] -- delay_bypass bypasses
    |   Mode: Slapback (delay_time) or Sync (delay_division)
    |   delay_feedback, delay_mix
    |   delay_reverb_send -> feeds into Reverb input
    |
    v
  [Reverb] -- reverb_bypass bypasses
    |   reverb_type (Plate/Room character)
    |   reverb_predelay, reverb_decay, reverb_damping, reverb_mix
    |
    v
[Stereo Output]
```

---

## Notes

- Parameters are implemented in EXACT order during Stage 2 (Shell)
- Parameter IDs are case-sensitive and must match exactly across APVTS, C++ relays, and JavaScript
- UI controls bind to these IDs via WebSliderRelay / WebToggleButtonRelay / WebComboBoxRelay
- 3 starter presets will be implemented: "Pop Vocal", "Rock Vocal", "Intimate"
- Signal format: Mono-in / Stereo-out (EQ and Comp work in mono; Delay and Reverb spread to stereo)
